jobs.description:
Your future job

As a production operator, you’ll provide support to the press operator during the production process. You’ll make sure that the glue goes into the correct glue tank and closely monitor the glue levels. In addition, you’ll welcome drivers and direct them to the right location.

You’ll also be responsible for maintenance tasks and cleaning the equipment, ensuring everything runs safely and smoothly.

In short: a varied role where you play an important part in keeping the production process efficient and well-organized!

Who are you?

• 
You speak good English and can communicate easily on the work floor.

• 
You’re not afraid of physical work and like to get things done.

• 
You don’t mind getting your hands dirty.

• 
You’re motivated to work in a 6-shift system.

Job description 

Our client in the Kortrijk/Menen region is looking for CE drivers for transporting sea containers. Usually for picking up and dropping off, but sometimes also just unloading at the quay. Nice working days of approximately 12 hours and home every day.

Loading and unloading locations at terminals in the ports of Ghent/Antwerp and at the client's warehouses and companies.

 Requirements 

You are motivated to work in the ports. You have a valid CE driving license with C95.

You have a good knowledge of Dutch, English, or French.

You live in the Kortrijk/Westhoek region.

jobs.occupation: CE Truck Driver with On-Board Forklift (Moffett)
jobs.description:
Job description 

Welcome to the wonderful world of truck drivers! You will hit the road with an impressive tractor-trailer combination. Waking up early is essential, as you will be leaving between 5 and 7 in the morning. Don't worry, you are allowed to work around 12 hours a day, which is more than enough time to make the asphalt disappear under your fantastic vehicle. Of course, you are a true adventurer, so crossing a border occasionally doesn't faze you. Fortunately, most of it is national work, so you won't need an international driving license.

You will make between 4 to 6 stops a day, which means you will spend a lot of time on the road. Naturally, as a superhero driver with a CE license, you will be responsible for loading, transporting, and delivering various goods. Do you have experience with a fork truck (kooiaap)? Then you have an advantage. But don't panic if that's not the case, because you can still receive training for it internally. And if you're a true night owl, you can also take night trips for this position. The choice is yours! Just let us know.

 Requirements 

    
• Driver's license: CE + code 95.
    
• Knowledge of Dutch, French, or English.

Job description 

Looking for freedom and your own dedicated truck (after your onboarding period)? This is your route:

    
• 
        
What: National transport (tipper and curtain-sider) of steel and miscellaneous materials.

    
    
• 
        
When: Early mornings (start between 4 AM and 6 AM) for a full 10-12 hour day.

    
    
• 
        
How: Independently, punctually, and in close contact with dispatch.

    

 Requirements 

    
• 
        
Valid CE license + Code 95.

    
    
• 
        
Speaks Dutch, French, or English.

    
    
• 
        
An early bird who loves working independently and accurately.

    
    
• 
        
An honest team player who cares for the equipment and the customer.

For one of our clients, a company specialising in the petrochemical sector and located in the centre of Brussels, we are looking for a Customer Service Officer. 

As a Customer Service Officier you will be responsible for the management of daily operations in the Customer Service Department and work closely together with 2 Sales Representatives. In general he/she is the interface for the different services within the organization and will specialized for commercial and marketing topics.

Your responsibilities as a Customer Service Officer :

Customers :* Handle requests and claims from customers by phone and by email;* Contracts & files : check input, rebates & additional services contracts;* Follow-up marketing actions decided by the Benelux Country Manager;* Order of new customer cards and toll box;* Follow-up portfolio of customers;* Help train the customers to use autonomously extranet, customer portal etc.

General administration :* Mails (post) and the e-mails on the general mailbox;* Sales support for the sales representatives : invoice, edit credit notes, etc;* Reporting activities;* Back-up of colleagues (customer service, sales officer).

Network :* Administrative help to Technical Manager;* Manual acceptance authorization;* Follow up of fraud cases in stations;* Resolve and help customers on issues related to cards and tolls.

The ideal profile of a Customer Service Officer :* You have a perfect command of Dutch, both spoken and written. You also have a very good knowledge of French, both spoken and written. Knowledge of English is an asset.* You have initial experience in Customer Service, Customer Care or file management.* You have a good knowledge of IT tools (MS Office) and are familiar with CRM systems.* You are an organised person, you are willing to take initiative and you have good customer relations skills.* You can easily switch between different tasks and have strong communication skills.

Do you also love fries and are looking for a new challenge? Our client is a leading player in the production and development of potato-based delicacies. Due to further growth of the Harelbeke site, we are looking for a Maintenance Technician in night shift As a maintenance technician, you are passionate about ensuring the reliability and efficiency of our machines and installations. Your goal? Ensure smooth operation and minimise downtime.
 
 
 
• Be an example in adhering to prescribed guidelines and procedures for a (food) safe, environmentally conscious, and orderly working environment. 
 
• As a technician, you recognise potential problems before they cause breakdowns. You report these findings accurately, allowing us to act proactively and minimise unplanned downtime. 
 
• You perform scheduled maintenance tasks, such as inspections, lubrications, adjustments and replacements. 
 
• You work closely with our operational teams and your technical colleagues to optimise the maintenance plan. 
 
• You provide external employees with the necessary support and follow-up to make their contribution effective and efficient. You also supervise technical trainees and new employees to help them grow in their roles. 
 
• You keep accurate records of maintenance work carried out, using the maintenance software (Ultimo). 

 
 
• You have a technical education or equivalent experience 
 
• You have several years of experience as a technician and a passion for technology 
 
• You have knowledge of mechanical, electrical, hydraulic and pneumatic systems 
 
• You have a proactive attitude 
 
• You have logical insight and good problem-solving skills, allowing you to work independently 
 
• You are a team player who contributes to smooth communication and joint success 
 
• You speak Dutch or French or English and are willing to understand other language colleagues 
 
• You are willing to work in night shift

 What will you do? 
    
• 
        
Play the early bird: The road is yours while the rest of the world is still hitting snooze.

    
    
•

•

•

•

• 
        
You are flexible, precise, and treat your truck as if it were your own.

    
    
• 
        
Want extra hours? Great! More hours = more cash.

Responsibilities

• Facilitate workshops and interviews with stakeholders to gather, analyze, and clarify complex business requirements.
• Translate business needs into conceptual models such as use case diagrams, activity diagrams, and information models.
• Refine requirements into user stories and collaborate with developers to ensure successful sprint delivery.
• Execute functional tests and support users during acceptance testing while conducting product demonstrations and training.
• Manage service requests and production issues to suggest continuous improvements for the product suite.
• Engage actively in Agile ceremonies including backlog refinement, sprint planning, and retrospectives.

Requirements

• You have 3+ years of experience in functional and business analysis within Agile methodologies such as Scrum, SAFe, or LeSS.
• You bring proficiency in modeling with UML and BPMN.

Responsibilities

• Lead modernization programs covering transition, cutover, and decommissioning phases.
• Design scalable and secure cloud architectures based on organizational requirements.

Nice to Haves

Lead the technical evolution of a modern cloud platform, combining .NET development, software architecture, AI-assisted engineering, and technical leadership.

Our partner is a technology-driven organization investing heavily in cloud-native development, AI-assisted software engineering, and modern platform architecture.

As part of a growing engineering team, they are looking for a Senior Developer / Tech Lead who can combine deep technical expertise with strong leadership capabilities.

This role goes far beyond pure development. You'll influence architectural decisions, mentor developers, drive engineering excellence, and help shape the future of an AI-native software delivery environment where AI agents actively support coding, testing, and refactoring activities.
Senior Tech Lead | The Role
• Design, build, and enhance scalable applications using .NET, C# and Microsoft Azure.
• Transform business requirements into robust technical solutions, architectures, and implementation plans.
• Establish and promote high engineering standards through code reviews, mentoring, and technical coaching.
• Work alongside AI-powered development tools to accelerate delivery while ensuring the quality, security, and maintainability of the resulting software.
• Drive architectural decisions and contribute to the evolution of cloud-native and event-driven systems.
• Identify opportunities to improve development practices, platform performance, delivery processes, and technical solutions.
Senior Tech Lead | The Profile
• You bring extensive experience in .NET / C# software development, ideally within complex enterprise environments.
• You have strong expertise with Microsoft Azure and cloud-based architectures.
• You are comfortable working with Docker, Kubernetes, CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices.
• You have experience with Angular or modern front-end development frameworks.
• You regularly leverage AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot, Claude Code, or similar solutions and understand both their strengths and limitations.
• You have a proven ability to lead technical discussions, mentor engineers, challenge architectural decisions, and drive software quality across a development team.
• Complete proficiency in Dutch, English and French
 

Nice to Have

• Experience with Event-Driven Architecture, messaging systems, and asynchronous integrations.
• Exposure to GraphQL, PostgreSQL, or document-oriented data management.
• Knowledge of Domain-Driven Design (DDD) and scalable software design practices.
• Experience with event sourcing patterns and distributed applications.
• Familiarity with modern search and analytics technologies.
• Microsoft Azure or DevOps certifications are considered a plus.

An organization primarily funded by the government of Belgium, it supports scientific research across various disciplines, providing grants and fellowships to researchers and scholars. It plays a crucial role in advancing knowledge and innovation within the country, contributing to scientific progress on both national and international levels.

Job Function

The hired individual will be attached to the International and Institutional Affairs Department – Mobility and Congress, primarily responsible for administrative management of the department.

Tasks

Administering the management of the department's email inquiries and secretarial tasks.

Processing various documents.

Providing administrative support to team members.

Receive briefings and requests for content creation from the various stakeholders in the organisation

Plan the copy work and communicate clear deadlines to the stakeholders, taking into account potential back-and-forth and validation.

Create content in line with the Thalys tone of voice and internal processes, taking account of SEO constraints

Ensuring that the content is validated by the various stakeholders before being sent to the translators

Proficient written and spoken English (minimum B2 level)

Excellent spelling and grammar

Ability to analyze and synthesize information

Organizational skills, attention to detail, dynamism, adaptability to priorities, and flexibility

Strong interpersonal skills and ability to work in a team

Proficiency in computer tools (MS Office)

Knowledge of the academic and research world

HCP Meetings And Contracts Management

Compliance

Excellent time-management, and critical thinking skills with ability to work effectively in a team, cross-functional, matrix, and global multi-cultural and virtual environment.
